newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PRIME MINISTER POSTPONES SLOVENIA VISIT.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PRIME MINISTER POSTPONES SLOVENIA VISIT.

text.p: Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz postponed an official July 21 visit to Slovenia because of floods which have swamped 3,500 sq km (2,200 sq miles) of southern Poland, killing 23 people.

The government press office said in a statement on Friday that Cimoszewicz wrote a personal letter to Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek to inform him of the decision. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
